text:
maria: FYI I'm prototyping a lightweight pulse -> ticket bridge for accounts that drop >15 points in health within 24h. want to try a dry run before we flip any playbooks on.
devon: love it. will the bridge create tickets or just a sampling webhook?
maria: sampling first. it'll create tickets with a low-priority tag and the playbook run id. purpose is to surface weird flaps to CS Ops.
leo: quick Q: how do we prevent noise from transient metric blips? we saw spikes last week when our telemetry ingestion lagged.
maria: good call. plan is: require 15pt drop + >2 distinct signal sources (usage, login, support events) AND ignore if healthsource=ingestion-lag for 3h.
jamie: can we add account age gating? new accounts are expected to fluctuate. maybe exclude accounts <14 days.
maria: yes adding account.age_days > 14. also we’ll include an index of recent contact attempts so tickets don’t fire for accounts with an open onboarding task.
devon: sample payload?
maria: paste: ```{
  "account_id": "acct_123",
  "delta_health": -18,
  "signals": ["usage","failed-login","support-escalation"],
  "reason": "health-trend-sample",
  "playbook_dryrun": true
}```
leo: nice. where does the ticket go? ops or dedicated cs triage?
maria: tickets open in CS-ops queue and get auto-tagged 'pulse-sample'. CS triage can opt into an annotated view in the admin console.
playbook-bot: Playbook dry-run scheduled by maria for 2023-07-21T15:05Z. Run id: run_20230721_15_05. Results will post to #customer-success in 1h.
jamie: timeline to test on prod sampling?
maria: I'll run a 24h sample on staging first then a 48h soft sampling on prod limited to 0.5% accounts. target start: Monday.
devon: +1 on gradual ramp. can you add a counter in the console for sampled vs alerted? want clear fallbacks.
maria: will add telemetry: sampled_count, ticket_created_count, suppressed_by_gating_count. visible in the playbook run UI.
leo: also log the most recent enablement-runbook id if present so triage sees last action.
maria: yep will include last_enablement_runbook_id and last_engagement_touch.
jamie: after the soft sample, propose a quick retro and adjust thresholds. I'll block 30m on Wed. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks all — I'll drop the staging run details in this thread when ready.
